# lodash.mergewith v4.6.1

The [Lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.mergeWith` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.mergewith
```

In Node.js:
```js
var mergeWith = require('lodash.mergewith');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#mergeWith) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.6.1-npm-packages/lodash.mergewith) for more details.
